title: Apply for personal injury benefits (motor vehicle accident)
summary: This page provides information on how to make a compulsory third party (CTP) insurance claim for personal injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident in NSW.
intro:
If you've been injured in a motor vehicle crash, you can make a compulsory third party (CTP) insurance claim. Benefits may include income support payments, medical expenses and/or vocational rehabilitation programs while you recover.

For a motor vehicle crash in NSW, make a report to the police to get an event number. Call the Police Assistance Line on 131 444 to report the crash. You can do this before lodging a CTP claim.

To receive back pay following your accident, the insurer needs to receive the claim within 28 days. You can submit a claim up to 3 months after the accident, but it’s best to submit a claim as soon as possible.
who_can_apply: Anyone who is injured in a motor vehicle crash in NSW
The motor vehicle crash must have occurred on or after 1 December 2017
what_you_need: Bank account details (if receiving payment by direct debit)
Police event number or other proof of the accident (such as news reports, photos of the accident scene, or witness statements)
Accident details (including date, time, place, and what happened)
Details of all vehicles involved in the accident (if known)
Ambulance and hospital stay details (if applicable)
A Certificate of Fitness/Capacity form completed by your treating doctor or General Practitioner (GP)
Details of any previous illnesses or injuries affecting the same or similar parts of your body (if applicable)
Employment details (if you were away from work)
'Proof of earnings' (such as payslips) if claiming for loss of income

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for personal injury benefits.
Complete the Application for Personal Injury Benefits form.
Attach any documents or information that helps the insurer to assess the claim, including your Certificate of Fitness/Capacity form, medical receipts and proof of earnings.
Send your application directly to the insurer.

faqs.q: What should I do immediately after a motor vehicle crash?
faqs.a: Make a report to the police to get an event number. You can call the Police Assistance Line on 131 444 to report the crash, even before lodging a CTP claim.

faqs.q: How long do I have to submit a CTP claim?
faqs.a: You can submit a claim up to 3 months after the accident, but it is best to submit it as soon as possible. To receive back pay, the insurer needs to receive the claim within 28 days.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for personal injury benefits?
faqs.a: Anyone who is injured in a motor vehicle crash in NSW can apply. This includes drivers, passengers, riders, pillion passengers, pedestrians, and cyclists. The crash must have occurred on or after 1 December 2017.
